title: Change application configuration settings
summary: Modify a specific setting for an application by writing a new value to its configuration.

steps.explain: Write a new value for a specific setting of an application. You must specify the data type (e.g., -string, -int, -bool, -float).

placeholders.name: APPLICATION
placeholders.description: The bundle identifier or name of the app

placeholders.name: VALUE
placeholders.description: The new value for the setting

warnings: Changing settings via Terminal can affect app behavior. Ensure you know the correct key and value.
Some apps need to be restarted for changes to take effect.

rollback.explain: There is no command on this page to delete a single specific option. To revert, you must manually re-enter the original value or delete all defaults for the application.
